decisions.decision: The Board asked the Applicant for: a firmer number on the cost of removal; an improved or alternate financial surety proposal that does not take ten years; increased buffering along the south and west property lines so panels cannot be seen from Northfield Road; and additional community engagement with direct abutters and visual simulations from visually abutting residences.
decisions.quote: a. burney summarized the additional information the board is looking for from the applicant:

decisions.decision: A. Burney was directed to research: speaking with the Fire Chief about a foam tanker; finding out who is negotiating the PILOT; speaking with UNITIL about the interconnection impact; and checking whether the Town has a solar advisor.
decisions.quote: a. burney will research the following:

decisions.decision: The Board understood the Town has a solar advisor and is seeking insight and clarification; A. Burney was to inquire.
decisions.quote: the board has the understanding that the town has a solar advisor and is looking for insight and clarification.
